oracle_scope: P112 single-factor detailed result parity; generated only by the pinned public Python API

reference.fingerprints_omitted: Python DataFrame fingerprints are not a cross-language parity key; compare canonical table rows and structural manifest fields.

holes.effect: Jan 11 entry price missing; both labels missing
Jan 15 2D study-tail label has no grid endpoint

price_construction.close_basis: open * 1.007; included to exercise both accepted wide price frames, not selected by next_open_to_open

sparsity.meaning: omitted panel key produces no signal/label rows; explicit NaN is retained in signal/label rows but excluded from finite/evaluable factor counts

contract.period_labels: Derived by pinned Python calendar helper from the supplied grid; the concrete oracle labels are in each manifest.
contract.utc: All accepted factor/grid/price timestamps are timezone-aware UTC. source_timezone is descriptive metadata, not a request to localize timestamps. Non-UTC factor index is rejected before evaluation.
contract.duplicate_keys: Factor MultiIndex keys, grid timestamps, and each prices index must be unique; errors retain Python exception class and machine code.
contract.missing_values: Non-finite float values serialize as JSON null. Compare null-to-null, never coerce null to zero or drop a row unless that table mask says so.
contract.orders: The table_rules below define public append order; table row order is part of this oracle.
contract.diagnostics: Compare factor/stage/severity/code/message and multiplicity; the list order is significant.
contract.factor_series_mapping: For C++ evaluate_factor_research_detailed, select the named factor column from factor_rows; each case is one exact public Python factor call.
contract.cross_factor_scope: Python correlation/comparisons tables are present with canonical columns and empty rows for these single-factor calls. Pairwise non-empty parity belongs to the separate multi-factor panel API, not this fixture.

signals.mask: all present factor-panel keys; NaN factor values remain rows; value is direction-adjusted raw value

labels.order: period-major, then panel time, asset ascending
labels.mask: every present panel key × every requested period; factor NaN, return NaN, and end-tail labels remain as null-valued rows

ic.mask: one row when finite factor/label pairs meet min_assets; degenerate Pearson or Spearman metric is null, not a dropped row

ic_summary.mask: one row for every factor × period, including unevaluable cases; n_dates counts finite Pearson IC observations

quantile_returns.order: factor-major, period-major, quantile ascending, time ascending
quantile_returns.mask: only successfully populated buckets with n_assets >= min_quantile_assets; n_assets is the cleaned bucket count

turnover.order: factor-major, period-major, quantile ascending, time ascending
turnover.mask: quantile membership turnover with lag parsed from period label (1D→1, 2D→2); rows without predecessor/finite turnover are omitted

spreads.mask: finite top-minus-bottom return spread when at least two bins exist; uses extreme populated bins before min_quantile_assets output filtering

stability.mask: rank autocorrelation summary over the full processed panel, independent of label availability; one row per requested lag, null metrics when n_dates=0

correlation.mask: pairwise-only output; empty for this single-factor detailed API case

comparisons.mask: explicit cross-factor comparisons only; empty because this single-factor spec requests none

coverage.order: factor input order, then combination input order
coverage.mask: input_cells counts present panel keys; finite_cells counts finite factor values; label_cells counts keys with any finite horizon; evaluable_cells is factor-finite ∩ any-label-finite

diagnostics.key: implicit append ordinal; diagnostic field tuples may repeat
diagnostics.order: Python diagnostic append order; duplicates are retained
diagnostics.mask: all emitted diagnostics; code/stage/severity are categorical, message is the exact public diagnostic text
